units.source_text: 舞女的黑发非常浓密，我一直以为她已有十七八岁了呢。

en.t: The dancer's black hair was so thick that I had always thought she was already seventeen or eighteen.

units.source_text: 再加上她装扮成一副妙龄女子的样子，我完全猜错了。

en.t: And since she was dressed like a young woman in the bloom of youth, I had completely misjudged her.
